```artifact
Feature: Alarm System Testing

  Scenario: Detect and receive alarms from GUI [RW-SW-66]
    Given the system is running
    When an alarm is triggered from the GUI with code "ALM-001" and priority "High"
    Then the controller receives the alarm with code "ALM-001" and priority "High"

  Scenario: Command the hardware PCB buzzer [RW-SW-67]
    Given the system is running
    When the controller receives a command to activate the buzzer
    Then the PCB buzzer is activated

  Scenario Outline: GUI enumerates alarm codes and assigns priorities [RW-SW-68]
    Given the system is running
    When the GUI requests the alarm list
    Then the GUI displays the alarm code "<alarm_code>" with priority "<priority>"
    Examples:
      | alarm_code | priority |
      | ALM-001    | High     |
      | ALM-002    | Medium   |
      | ALM-003    | Low      |
      | ALM-999    | High     |

  Scenario: GUI displays highest priority alarm on main screen [RW-SW-69]
    Given the system is running
    And alarms "ALM-001" (High), "ALM-002" (Medium), and "ALM-003" (Low) are active
    When the main screen is displayed
    Then the main screen displays alarm "ALM-001" with priority "High"

  Scenario: GUI displays list of active alarms on button press [RW-SW-70]
    Given the system is running
    And alarms "ALM-001" (High), "ALM-002" (Medium), and "ALM-003" (Low) are active
    When the "Show Alarms" button is pressed
    Then the GUI displays a list containing alarms "ALM-001", "ALM-002", and "ALM-003"

  Scenario: GUI displays alarm on main screen legible at distance of 1 meter [RW-SW-71]
    Given the system is running
    And an alarm "ALM-001" (High) is active
    When the main screen is displayed
    Then the alarm "ALM-001" is displayed with a font size that is legible at a distance of 1 meter as specified

  Scenario Outline: High severity alarms indicated with red color and 2Hz flashing [RW-SW-73]
    Given the system is running
    And an alarm "<alarm_code>" with severity "High" is active
    When the main screen is displayed
    Then the alarm "<alarm_code>" is displayed in red color
    And the alarm "<alarm_code>" flashes at a frequency of 2Hz with a 50% duty cycle
    Examples:
      | alarm_code |
      | ALM-001    |
      | ALM-999    |

  Scenario Outline: Low severity alarms indicated with yellow color and constantly on [RW-SW-74]
    Given the system is running
    And an alarm "<alarm_code>" with severity "Low" is active
    When the main screen is displayed
    Then the alarm "<alarm_code>" is displayed in yellow color
    And the alarm "<alarm_code>" is constantly on
    Examples:
      | alarm_code |
      | ALM-003    |
      | ALM-123    |
```
